dl.dd: A short term sits in the hanging indent, and the description begins on the same line.
A term longer than the term size is followed by one blank, and the description continues on the same line.

body.p: tsize=6 (characters, quoted in the source), break:

dl.dd: Short terms are not affected by break.
With break, the description of a term longer than the term size starts on the next line.
One and a half inches hold this term.
